glosses.notes: Describes something that covers all the important sides of a matter.

examples.sentence: 这份计划考虑得很全面。
examples.translation: This plan has been thought through from every angle.

examples.sentence: 医生建议他做一次全面检查。
examples.translation: The doctor suggested that he get a full checkup.

examples.sentence: 报道问题时要尽量全面。
examples.translation: When reporting on an issue, you should be as thorough as possible.

example_translations.translation: This plan has been thought through from every angle.
The doctor suggested that he get a full checkup.
When reporting on an issue, you should be as thorough as possible.

glosses.notes: Refers to every member of a group taken together.

examples.sentence: 请全体同学明天八点到操场集合。
examples.translation: All students should gather on the playground at eight tomorrow.

examples.sentence: 消息一公布，全体员工都鼓掌了。
examples.translation: As soon as the news was announced, the whole staff applauded.

examples.sentence: 老师向全体家长说明了情况。
examples.translation: The teacher explained the situation to all the parents.

example_translations.translation: All students should gather on the playground at eight tomorrow.
As soon as the news was announced, the whole staff applauded.
The teacher explained the situation to all the parents.

glosses.notes: Describes something entirely new, either newly made or new in style or approach.

examples.sentence: 他买了一辆全新的车。
examples.translation: He bought a brand-new car.

examples.sentence: 搬家以后，他们买了全新的家具。
examples.translation: After moving, they bought brand-new furniture.

examples.sentence: 她想用全新的方法教孩子认字。
examples.translation: She wants to teach children to recognize characters with a completely new method.

example_translations.translation: He bought a brand-new car.
After moving, they bought brand-new furniture.
She wants to teach children to recognize characters with a completely new method.

glosses.notes: Used when trying to get someone to do something or stop doing something by talking to them. It often means to urge or advise, and it can also mean to persuade.

examples.sentence: 我劝他先冷静下来再说。
examples.translation: I urged him to calm down first and talk later.

examples.sentence: 大家都劝她别一个人去。
examples.translation: Everyone urged her not to go alone.

examples.sentence: 妈妈劝他早点睡觉。
examples.translation: His mother advised him to go to bed earlier.

example_translations.translation: I urged him to calm down first and talk later.
Everyone urged her not to go alone.
His mother advised him to go to bed earlier.

glosses.notes: Used for not having enough of something needed, such as experience, patience, or exercise.

examples.sentence: 这份工作最怕缺乏耐心。
examples.translation: The biggest problem in this job is lacking patience.

examples.sentence: 孩子如果缺乏运动，身体会变差。
examples.translation: If children lack exercise, their health will get worse.

examples.sentence: 他不是没能力，只是缺乏经验。
examples.translation: It is not that he lacks ability; he is just short of experience.

example_translations.translation: The biggest problem in this job is lacking patience.
If children lack exercise, their health will get worse.
It is not that he lacks ability; he is just short of experience.

glosses.notes: Used for making certain that something will happen or that a condition is satisfied.

examples.sentence: 出门前一定要确保门已经锁好。
examples.translation: Before going out, make sure the door is locked properly.

examples.sentence: 我们得提前出发，确保准时到。
examples.translation: We need to leave early to make sure we arrive on time.

examples.sentence: 医生会再检查一次，确保没有问题。
examples.translation: The doctor will check once again to ensure there is no problem.

example_translations.translation: Before going out, make sure the door is locked properly.
We need to leave early to make sure we arrive on time.
The doctor will check once again to ensure there is no problem.

glosses.notes: As a verb, 确定 means to settle or determine something. As an adjective, it means certain or definite.

examples.sentence: 时间还没确定，我们先别买票。
examples.translation: The time has not been settled yet, so let’s not buy tickets first.

examples.sentence: 他很确定自己没有记错。
examples.translation: He is quite sure that he remembered it correctly.

examples.sentence: 医生要先检查，才能确定原因。
examples.translation: The doctor has to do an examination first before determining the cause.

example_translations.translation: The time has not been settled yet, so let’s not buy tickets first.
He is quite sure that he remembered it correctly.
The doctor has to do an examination first before determining the cause.

glosses.notes: Used for checking and stating that something is true, correct, or settled.

examples.sentence: 请你再确认一下会议时间。
examples.translation: Please confirm the meeting time once again.

examples.sentence: 收到钱以后，我会马上确认。
examples.translation: After receiving the money, I will confirm it right away.

examples.sentence: 医生确认他已经退烧了。
examples.translation: The doctor confirmed that his fever had gone down.

example_translations.translation: Please confirm the meeting time once again.
After receiving the money, I will confirm it right away.
The doctor confirmed that his fever had gone down.

glosses.primary_gloss: measure word for groups of people or animals
glosses.notes: Used as a measure word for groups of people or animals, as in 一群孩子 or 一群鸟.

examples.sentence: 门口来了一群孩子。
examples.translation: A group of children came to the door.

examples.sentence: 湖边有一群鸟正在休息。
examples.translation: A flock of birds was resting by the lake.

examples.sentence: 她一进门，就被一群记者围住了。
examples.translation: As soon as she walked in, she was surrounded by a group of reporters.

example_translations.translation: A group of children came to the door.
A flock of birds was resting by the lake.
As soon as she walked in, she was surrounded by a group of reporters.

glosses.notes: Refers to a category or body of people viewed as one group.

examples.sentence: 这个节目主要面向年轻群体。
examples.translation: This program is aimed mainly at young people.

examples.sentence: 医生提醒老年群体多注意休息。
examples.translation: Doctors remind older people to pay more attention to rest.

examples.sentence: 这个问题在年轻群体中很常见。
examples.translation: This issue is very common among young people.

example_translations.translation: This program is aimed mainly at young people.
Doctors remind older people to pay more attention to rest.
This issue is very common among young people.
